text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm heading to my office with Matikanetannhauser, when…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah… It's been hurting since I woke up this morning. I wonder if I did something unhealthy…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's see… I've been getting plenty of sleep recently.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There haven't been any major changes to my workout schedule, and I'm eating plenty.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, the air pressure is low today. Maybe that's it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've got it! I'll make a sunshine doll to help the weather improve when I get back to my room!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Rain, rain, go away! Munmunmun another day!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Owww… Singing makes my head throb…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser continues to suffer from her headache for some time.
